name: Geopede
description: A giant geopede suspended as a trap in the Skyclave and killed by Nissa and Nahiri.

timeline.summary: The elemental taps a geopede trap and Nissa and Nahiri kill the fallen creature.
timeline.quote: The monster shrieked and twitched. Then it went limp and expired.
